about_the_game:
Are There Bunny Girls in the Corner Store?

Genre: Visual Novel · Slice of Life · Card Battler
Setting: A cozy city-side corner shop where fantasy meets everyday life

Overview

Are There Bunny Girls in the Corner Store? is a lighthearted and heartwarming visual novel set in a small, unassuming corner store with a very unusual staff.

You step in for a snack or a drink… and end up caught in conversations with four charming bunny girls — each with her own quirks, charm, and hidden reasons for donning the fluffy ears.

As you keep returning to the store, casual chats turn into genuine connections. What begins as curiosity soon becomes something deeper — friendship, affection, or maybe even love.

Story

The story begins on the day of Bunny Mart’s grand opening, a bizarre corner shop where the staff are all dressed as bunny girls.
You, a curious passerby, find yourself drawn inside — and into the orbit of:

  • Akari, the bubbly front desk girl who believes every smile can change someone’s day.

  • Mina, the quiet tech girl who feels more comfortable with gadgets than people.

  • Sakura, the dreamy romantic who sees beauty in every ordinary moment.

  • Luna, the confident store manager with a sharp tongue and a soft heart she refuses to show.

Over time, your visits to Bunny Mart turn into a routine — and each conversation brings you closer to understanding who these girls truly are behind their cheerful roles.

But nothing stays simple forever.
Even in a store full of laughter and cute costumes, everyone hides their own reason for being there… including you.

Features:

  • SImple card battler

  • 4 Romanable girls

  • Relax in a warm, feel-good world with a touch of fantasy charm

short_description: A cozy, flirty visual novel set in a small corner store with an unexpected twist, the clerks are all bunny girls. Visit daily, chat, and uncover their secrets as you fall into the charm of Corner Store 24. You came for snacks… but stayed for something sweeter.
